title: 自主智能体数据工程：面向模型专业化的端到端数据策展
summary: 本文提出“自主智能体数据工程”任务，让LLM作为自主数据工程师，通过规划、生成和迭代优化训练数据来驱动模型专业化。实验表明，GPT-5.2通过智能体驱动的数据适应，使学生模型性能提升57.29%，展示了自主数据工程的潜力与瓶颈。
summary_en: This paper proposes Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering, where LLMs act as autonomous data engineers to plan, generate, and iteratively optimize training data for model specialization. Experiments show GPT-5.2 improves a student model by 57.29% through agent-driven data adaptation, revealing potential and bottlenecks.
